_comment: Calibrated 2026-08-03 against the live mini store: 2.30 GiB with no sessions old enough for the 45-day prune horizon, only ~2.1 MiB vacuum-reclaimable, and ~1.7 GiB in FTS/trigram indexes that shrink only after real pruning plus a separately approved VACUUM. At 150 MiB/day, the retained horizon is ~6.59 GiB; the 8 GiB profile/root budgets preserve retention with headroom while lifecycle growth metrics provide an earlier trend signal. root.max_bytes counts session databases only (default state.db plus profiles/*/state.db and their WAL/SHM sidecars), not the whole Hermes home.
